Task Satiation vs. Aggregate Rebound in AI Demand

Every single task has a hard finish line—even while cheaper AI sparks millions of new tasks across the economy.

[One Job Finishes · Total Jobs Still Grow]

1/3 Every job has a finish line, and extra computer work after that point is pure waste.

2/3 Cheaper computer work still inspires people to start many more jobs, so total use keeps rising.

3/3 Money prices for AI are falling fast, but the physical electricity it burns is never free.

Energy class: unmetered (Theory + Price Audit; joules=null, never faked as zero).
